events.title: US-Iran War / Hormuz Blockade — Trump Reinstates Blockade
events.summary: Trump reinstated naval blockade Aug 12. Iran rejects US 'total control' claims. Hormuz remains blocked — traffic at near 3-month lows. Iran's new security chief Rezaie demands: US end war, unfreeze assets, region-wide ceasefire including Gaza/Lebanon. Turkey reports 60-day ceasefire extension agreement. Iran FM Araghchi says US 'miscalculated.' No deal exists.
events.update: Turkey reports 60-day ceasefire extension. Iran expands demands to include Gaza/Lebanon. Traffic at 3-month lows.

events.title: US-Japan Yen Intervention Unraveling — Takaichi Pushes Faster Hikes
events.summary: Bloomberg (Aug 13): Takaichi government supports faster BOJ rate hike, next move Sep or Oct. CNBC: Yen erased half of intervention gains. Bessent-Takaichi rift on BOJ policy clouds coordinated defense. Goldman says $1T reserves allows more interventions. BOJ held at 1% around intervention time, limiting impact.
events.update: Takaichi government now publicly pushing BOJ for faster hikes. Bessent-Takaichi rift emerging. Escalation from ONGOING to ESCALATING.

events.title: Ebola PHEIC — Spreads to 6th Province, Could Become Deadliest Ever
events.summary: Guardian (Aug 13): Ebola spreads to 6th province in DRC. 53 health zones affected across 5 provinces. WHO warns cases and deaths surging — could become deadliest ever. Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine. Uganda outbreak declared over Jul 28 but DRC accelerating. MSF running PARTNERS trial.
events.update: Severity upgraded 4→5. Spread to 6th province. WHO warns could become deadliest ever. WORSENING.

events.update: Gold holding above $4,400. Dec futures at $4,441-4,468. +10% MoM. Burry crash warning adds signal.
